svg.title: Hunter Valley (NSW) study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Hunter Valley; 2: Pokolbin; 3: Lovedale; 4: Mount View; 5: Cessnock; 6: Broke; 7: Abernethy; 8: Ellalong; 9: Newcastle; 10: Maitland; 11: Singleton; 12: Muswellbrook

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
